title: Northwestern vs OSU: control, tuition, size
summary: Northwestern University (Northwestern) versus Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (OSU). Also searched as OSU vs Northwestern. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Northwestern University vs Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (Northwestern vs OSU) differ significantly in ownership, size, cost, and location. Northwestern is a private nonprofit institution located in Evanston with an undergraduate enrollment of 9,201 students. In contrast, Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute is a public institution situated in Wooster, enrolling 464 undergraduates. Tuition costs also vary widely, with Northwestern charging $68,322 for in-state students, while Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute's in-state tuition is $9,584. These differences highlight the distinct characteristics of each institution.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing cost, Northwestern University vs Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (Northwestern vs OSU) show notable differences in tuition and student debt. Northwestern charges $68,322 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition, reflecting its status as a private institution. In contrast, Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute, a public college, has an in-state tuition of $9,584 and an out-of-state tuition of $36,362. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Northwestern is $15,000, while at Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute it is slightly higher at $19,976. These figures illustrate the financial considerations prospective students might weigh when choosing between these two institutions.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: Northwestern University vs Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute (Northwestern vs OSU) differ in their learning models and campus settings. Northwestern University, located in Evanston, Illinois, has a large undergraduate enrollment of 9,201 students, reflecting its comprehensive academic environment. In contrast, Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute is situated in Wooster, Ohio, with a smaller undergraduate population of 464 students, indicative of a more specialized and intimate campus experience. These differences in size and location contribute to distinct educational atmospheres at each institution.

sections.heading: Pick Northwestern if
paragraphs: Pick Northwestern University if you prefer a private nonprofit institution with a highly selective admission rate of approximately 7.7%. Northwestern charges $68,322 for tuition, reflecting its private status without differentiation between in-state and out-of-state rates. The university boasts a high completion rate of about 95.1%, indicating strong student retention and success. These factors make Northwestern suitable for students seeking a prestigious, competitive environment with a commitment to degree completion.

sections.heading: Pick OSU if
paragraphs: Pick Ohio State University Agricultural Technical Institute if you are looking for a public institution with more affordable in-state tuition costs, which are $9,584.
